$comment: Reviewed licence exceptions for the Rust crates, keyed by exact name@version so every upgrade is re-checked. All are test-only: proptest's dependency tree (tools/vimma-ctl dev-dependencies, docs/specs/m7-fuzzing.md); none is in the vimma-ctl binary.

unicode-ident@1.0.26.reason: MIT or Apache, plus the Unicode License v3 (OSI-approved, permissive) for its generated tables; compile-time only, via proptest > rand_chacha > ppv-lite86 > zerocopy-derive > syn

wasip2@1.0.1+wasi-0.2.4.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT
wasip2@1.0.1+wasi-0.2.4.reason: MIT is one of the choices; the checker cannot parse WITH. A WASI-only dependency of getrandom, never built for Linux; via proptest > rand

wit-bindgen@0.46.0.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT
wit-bindgen@0.46.0.reason: MIT is one of the choices; the checker cannot parse WITH. A WASI-only dependency of getrandom (via wasip2), never built for Linux
